item.title: NIF Controversy, BPL Overtime, Fire Trail Homicide
item.ns0:title: NIF Controversy, BPL Overtime, Fire Trail Homicide
item.description:
T

Tonight on Our News, a major political showdown intensifies over the movement of millions from the National Investment Fund as police search for a gunman following a fatal shooting at a Fire Trail residence. We investigate a massive BPL payroll leak that has sparked outrage from union leaders and bring you the latest developments in a high-profile home invasion and murder sentencing. Our team joins a grieving family picking up the pieces after a devastating house fire and explores the potential fallout from significant changes to U.S. migration policies. Plus, we bring you the details of a ten-year prison sentence for a local gun supplier and celebrate the latest Bahamian successes on the international sports stage. ----- Copyright Disclaimer under section 107 of the Copyright Act of 1976, allowance is made for "fair use" for purposes such as criticism, comment, news reporting, teaching, scholarship, education and research.
